title: Suit Handbook
summary: The Suit Handbook is a book containing pieces of advice and rules for Suits of the Organization.

sections.heading: Quotes
sections.text:
• "Never let your target elude you." –Suit handbook, page 28 [LGS-072]
• "Do not use Darkwave while chasing a target. Keep your feet FIRMLY planted on the ground." –Suit Handbook, page 72 [LGS-078]
• "Do not attempt a fair fight. Eliminate your target's options to ensure an advantage." -Suit Handbook, page 41 [OAL-090]
